exposure: Duration of second stage of labor
cohort: 51,592 births at Aberdeen Maternity Hospital between 2000 and 2016
finding: Each hourly increase in the second stage of labor was associated with an increased risk of obstetric anal sphincter injury, episiotomy, and postpartum haemorrhage.
mod_finding: The rates of caesarean and forceps delivery also increased with increasing duration of second stage of labor.
